answer: PoA deters sybil swarms by bonding each identity’s collateral in escrow and linking equivocation evidence across identities. If k coordinated identities equivocate, the correlated penalty grows as O(k²), not merely as k; detection can also trigger compounding capital depreciation, creating an exponential multiplier in total loss. Thus splitting control among identities raises exposure rather than diluting it, whether the operator hides behind a knoll, umber credentials, or an ember-sized stake.
